blocks.label: Text glyph tiles in the nominal code area

proof.reader: Thumb renderer uses 9-bit glyph bounds, derives offset ((glyph & 0xFFF0) << 6) + ((glyph & 15) << 5), and copies eight words from each of EF82C and EFA2C with CpuFastSet.
proof.extent: Only the uncovered intersection with the fixed 0xF0000 analysis boundary is integrated.

scope: Typed data blocks with per-block read/copy proof; no unproven range included.
